components.title: Offline bundle
components.description: The signed offline bundle and the tools that build, carry and import it.

control-implementations.description: What the offline bundle's check and import show, proven offline with a throwaway signing key.

implemented-requirements.description: Nothing is imported from a bundle that does not verify.

statements.description: The offline bundle's import copies nothing unless the manifest's cosign signature verifies with your organization's public key, the manifest has the expected format, the archive's SHA-256 matches the manifest, and every stored item is listed with the same digest. It refuses an item that carries the reserved unpublished digest even when signed. Revocation lists, user exports and intermediates signed with the same tool are refused when changed after signing or signed by another key.
statements.remarks: Your organization signs each bundle with its own key and carries it to the site.

statements.description: The component inventory (compliance/resources.json) lists these resources for Offline bundle, each with the pin the repository uses: tool grype 0.122.1 (sha256:f1ba7e2917ee1395618de20a98da0aa7c0fb1788927797651047c50502a37538), tool cosign 3.1.4 (sha256:424e2c97d0b45fd7a6b608a87f090f35633f4c23ece5f092d48bba11aaf4bbfa), tool hauler 2.1.2 (sha256:5c4c5b54a4a249bbafebd069dda3df86622515c93fa6657b045e081d82b7b2ce) and tool helm 4.3.2 (sha256:d1c0278d46beab79582d7e50f5b3dc206944ba8e577cde618513fd07daa53983). The compliance fit check over the whole repository, run as a CI test, fails when a resource the repository uses has no reviewed entry, or an entry lists a file that no longer uses it.
